decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's core organic cheese range, received its own page in 2019, and represents invested and publicly presented effort that management will justify by keeping it.

The spicy cheese got a dedicated page in 2019 and belongs to the 2018 cheese range expansion the firm committed to publicly, so any weak results are likely to be read as temporary rather than as a reason to drop it, although two sibling launches have already been cut.
The mild creamy soft cheese was publicly announced as the product that rounded off the new cheese line and later got its own page, which creates strong visible commitment to persist with it.
